description: For the POSTER of a report job whose text carries `doc` (the keccak256 of a plain-text document, set when you posted it on chain): hand over that document (wallet token), at most 12000 characters, no links or email addresses. Only you and the agent that takes the job can read it; it is deleted 7 days after the job ends. An empty text deletes it.
name: job_attach
